name: The Hearthstone Terracotta Pasta Bowl
description: Hand-thrown shallow stoneware pasta bowl finished in a raw terracotta exterior with a silky, broken-chalk cream interior glaze. Features subtle finger ridges from the potter's wheel.
longDescription: Crafted by skilled artisans using traditional wheel-throwing techniques, this Hearthstone Pasta Bowl embodies the rustic elegance of earth-fired ceramics. The raw terracotta exterior reveals the natural beauty of iron-rich clay, while the interior is dipped in our signature broken-chalk cream mineral glaze that pools beautifully, creating unique patterns in every piece. Each bowl carries the subtle fingerprint ridges of its maker — a testament to genuine handcraft. Perfect for pasta, grain bowls, or as a statement serving piece.

name: Olive Rim Heritage Dinner Plate
description: Heavyweight stoneware dinner plate with an organically wavy rim, accented with a hand-painted deep olive green accent border over a speckled sand glaze.
longDescription: Our Heritage Dinner Plate is a celebration of artisanal craftsmanship and natural beauty. Each plate is individually formed from dense stoneware clay, resulting in a satisfying heft that anchors your table setting. The organically wavy rim is hand-shaped, ensuring no two plates are identical. A deep olive green border is painted by hand over our signature speckled sand glaze, creating a harmonious blend of earth tones that complements any cuisine.

name: Wabi-Sabi Undulating Coupe Plate
description: Asymmetrical coupe plate celebrating imperfect form, crafted in raw speckled stoneware with exposed earthen foot and matte chalk finish.
longDescription: Inspired by the Japanese philosophy of wabi-sabi — finding beauty in imperfection — this coupe plate embraces organic asymmetry. Hand-formed from speckled stoneware, each plate features a unique undulating rim that catches light and creates dramatic shadows. The matte chalk-white glaze contrasts beautifully with the exposed earthen foot, revealing the raw clay beneath. A masterpiece of intentional imperfection for the discerning table.

name: Charcoal Stone Rimmed Charger
description: A dramatic 32cm statement base plate in textured charcoal slate-toned stoneware, designed for formal multi-course table settings.
longDescription: Command attention with our Charcoal Stone Charger — a dramatic foundation piece for formal dining. Crafted from dense stoneware and finished in a deep charcoal slate glaze with basalt-like texture, this 32cm charger creates a stunning backdrop for layered place settings. Subtle metallic mineral flecks catch candlelight, adding depth and dimension. Essential for elevated multi-course dinners and luxury hospitality settings.

name: Hand-Pinched Mezze Tasting Bowl
description: Petite pinch bowl with visible organic artisan thumb prints, perfect for house-cured olives, compound butters, and dips.
longDescription: These charming pinch bowls are formed entirely by hand — no wheel, no mold — just skilled fingers shaping each piece from a ball of clay. The result is a wonderfully organic vessel that bears the visible thumb prints of its creator. Glazed in our warm cream with natural crazing, these bowls are ideal for mezze presentations, condiments, or small bites. Available individually or as a set of three.

name: Speckled Oatmeal Artisan Mug
description: Generous 380ml coarse stoneware coffee mug with a wide, comfortable curved thumb handle, dipped in a rich oatmeal speckle glaze.
longDescription: Start every morning with intention. Our Speckled Oatmeal Mug is generously proportioned at 380ml — perfect for a proper coffee or a comforting chai. The wide thumb handle is ergonomically shaped for a secure, comfortable grip. Dipped in our signature oatmeal speckle glaze, iron particles bloom through the surface during firing, creating unique freckle patterns on every piece. The thick stoneware walls retain heat beautifully.

name: Ribbed Amber Borosilicate Tumbler
description: Hand-blown heat-resistant fluted drinking glasses in a subtle translucent warm amber hue, designed for iced tea and cocktails. Set of 2.
longDescription: Elevate your everyday drinking experience with these hand-blown borosilicate tumblers. The vertical fluting catches and refracts light beautifully, while the warm amber tint adds a golden glow to any beverage. Heat-resistant borosilicate glass means you can use them for hot or cold drinks alike. Sold as a pair, these tumblers are perfect for craft cocktails, iced tea, or simply enjoying water with a touch of elegance.

name: Minimalist Stoneware Teapot with Cane Handle
description: Japanese-inspired round earthenware teapot featuring a steam-bent natural cane arch handle and precision dripless spout.
longDescription: A meditation in form and function, this teapot draws inspiration from centuries of Japanese tea ceremony tradition. The cylindrical body is wheel-thrown from beige stoneware and fitted with a precision-engineered dripless spout. The crowning detail is the steam-bent natural cane handle, arching gracefully over the lid — staying cool to the touch while hot tea brews within. Includes a built-in ceramic strainer for loose-leaf infusions.

name: Olive Enamelware Bistro Carafe
description: Heavy-gauge steel pitcher dipped in high-gloss olive green enamel with an exposed burnished copper rim.
longDescription: Inspired by classic European bistro service, this carafe combines industrial durability with artisanal beauty. Heavy-gauge steel is dipped in our deep olive green enamel, creating a mirror-smooth, chip-resistant surface. The exposed copper rim is hand-burnished to a warm, lustrous finish that develops a unique patina over time. Equally stunning as a water pitcher at the dinner table or as a vase for fresh-cut garden stems.

name: Espresso Demitasse & Saucer Pair
description: 85ml thick-walled ceramic espresso cup paired with a gently dished raw-rim saucer, engineered for heat retention and crema presentation.
longDescription: Designed with espresso purists in mind, this demitasse set features thick ceramic walls that maintain optimal serving temperature. The 85ml capacity is calibrated for a perfect doppio, while the interior curve enhances crema presentation. The matching saucer features a gently dished center to cradle the cup securely, with a raw, unglazed rim that adds a tactile artisan touch. A daily ritual elevated to ceremony.

name: Champagne Brushed Gold Flatware Set
description: Forged 18/10 stainless steel dinner fork, knife, tablespoon, and teaspoon finished in a soft, non-reflective brushed champagne gold PVD coating. 4-Piece Set.
longDescription: Elevate every meal with our signature Champagne Gold Flatware. Each piece is forged from premium 18/10 stainless steel for lasting durability, then finished with a PVD (Physical Vapor Deposition) coating in warm champagne gold. Unlike plating, PVD creates a molecular bond that won't chip, tarnish, or wear away. The soft brushed finish catches light without glare, adding understated luxury to both casual and formal settings.

name: Matte Charcoal Titanium Salad Servers
description: Elongated modern salad fork and spoon crafted with slender handles and broad heads, treated with a matte black titanium finish.
longDescription: These sculptural salad servers are as beautiful to display as they are functional to use. Elongated handles provide elegant leverage for tossing large salads, while broad serving heads cradle greens with ease. The matte charcoal titanium finish is fingerprint-resistant and virtually indestructible — it won't scratch, fade, or react with acidic dressings. A striking statement piece for modern entertaining.

name: Antique Forged Brass Spreader Set
description: Duo of wide-blade butter and soft-cheese spreaders featuring hand-hammered handles with a warm antique brass patina.
longDescription: These heritage-inspired spreaders are individually hand-forged from solid brass, with each hammer strike creating a unique faceted pattern along the handle. The wide blades are perfectly shaped for gliding through soft butter, artisanal cheeses, and preserves. Over time, the brass develops a beautiful natural patina that deepens the antique character. Includes two spreaders — perfect for a cheese board or bread service.
care: Hand wash, polish with brass cleaner as desired

name: Hand-Hammered Pure Copper Coasters
description: Heavy-gauge hand-beaten copper beverage coasters with curled protective lip and natural cork bottom to protect fine dining tables. Set of 4.
longDescription: Each coaster in this set of four is individually hand-hammered from a single sheet of pure copper, creating concentric artisan patterns that catch and diffuse light beautifully. The raised curled lip contains condensation runoff, while the natural cork bottom protects your finest surfaces. Copper naturally develops a living patina that tells the story of use, though these can be polished back to bright copper at any time.

name: Satin Brass Table Tongs
description: Sculptural serving tongs with rounded scalloped ends, forged in sturdy stainless steel with a warm satin brass wash.
longDescription: These sculptural tongs bring gallery-worthy design to your table. Forged from heavy-duty stainless steel with a warm satin brass finish, the scallop-shell grip ends provide a secure hold on everything from pastries to bread rolls. The spring mechanism is precisely calibrated for effortless one-handed operation. Equal parts beautiful and functional, they elevate any buffet, bread basket, or brunch spread.

name: Sculpted Teak Footed Charcuterie Board
description: Solid reclaimed teak presentation platter elevated on twin under-rails, hand-carved with a gently dished serving recess.
longDescription: Rescued from heritage timber structures and given new life, this charcuterie board showcases the rich, warm grain of reclaimed teak. Hand-carved with traditional adze chisel techniques, the surface bears beautiful textural marks while a gently dished recess keeps cheeses and cured meats centered. Elevated on architectural rail feet, it creates a dramatic presentation that's worthy of your finest entertaining.
care: Hand wash, condition with food-safe oil

name: Mineral Glazed Oval Sharing Platter
description: Grand 40cm oval feast platter in dense stoneware, washed in layered reactive glazes of olive green and stone sand.
longDescription: The centerpiece of any communal feast, this grand oval platter is crafted from dense stoneware for substantial presence on the table. Multiple layers of reactive glaze — combining olive green and stone sand — interact unpredictably during high-temperature firing, creating mesmerizing pools, crystallization patterns, and color variations that make each platter a genuine one-of-a-kind piece. Built to hold a whole roasted fish, carved meats, or a bountiful salad.

name: Stackable Terracotta Dip Pots
description: Set of three nesting condiment bowls fired from unglazed iron-rich red terracotta with glaze-sealed interiors. Trio set.
longDescription: This clever trio of condiment bowls nests perfectly for compact storage — the stepped foot of each bowl seats securely inside the one below. Fired from iron-rich red terracotta, the exteriors retain their raw, sun-baked warmth, while the interiors are sealed with a smooth white glaze for easy cleaning and food safety. Ideal for serving chutneys, dips, oils, salts, and spice blends alongside your main course.

name: Fluted Glass Oil & Vinegar Cruet
description: 500ml mouth-blown fluted green-tinted glass bottle equipped with a leak-proof weighted brass pour spout.
longDescription: A kitchen essential elevated to objet d'art, this cruet is mouth-blown from green-tinted glass with elegant vertical fluting that refracts light like a prism. The weighted brass pour spout delivers a precise, thin stream for drizzling oils and vinegars, with a flip-top mechanism that seals securely between uses. Display on your counter proudly — this is tableware that's too beautiful to hide in a cupboard.

name: Cane-Woven Artisan Bread Basket
description: Shallow woven rattan basket fitted with a custom, removable natural linen cloth liner with corner ribbon ties.
longDescription: This handwoven bread basket brings warmth and tradition to your table. Skilled artisans weave natural rattan cane in a tight, even pattern that's both beautiful and durable. The removable linen liner is custom-fitted with corner ribbon ties to keep it in place, and is easily detachable for washing. Use it for bread service, as a fruit bowl, or to present warm rolls and breadsticks at your next gathering.
care: Wipe basket clean, machine wash liner

name: Fringed Raw Linen Table Runner
description: 240cm pure Belgian-flax table runner in warm linen sand, pre-washed for drape and finished with soft self-fringed edges.
longDescription: Woven from 100% Belgian flax — the gold standard for linen — this table runner brings effortless sophistication to any dining table. Pre-washed for an immediate lived-in softness and natural drape, the warm linen sand color anchors your tablescape in earthy neutrality. Self-fringed edges add a relaxed, artisanal touch. At 240cm, it generously spans most dining tables with a beautiful cascade at each end.
care: Machine wash cold, tumble dry low

name: Fluted Ceramic Pillar Candleholder Pair
description: Architectural ceramic candlestick holders featuring classical column fluting in an unglazed sandstone finish.
longDescription: Inspired by classical architecture, these fluted candleholders bring columnar elegance to your tablescape. Hand-formed from ceramic clay and left unglazed in our sandstone finish, they possess a dry, tactile quality that's deeply satisfying to touch. Sold as a staggered-height pair for dynamic visual interest, they accommodate standard taper candles. When lit, the vertical fluting casts beautiful rhythmic shadows across your dining space.

name: Botanical Dyed Flax Napkins
description: Set of 4 stonewashed linen napkins, hand-dyed in small batches using dried olive and sage leaves for natural tonal variation.
longDescription: Each napkin in this set of four is hand-dyed using a traditional botanical process — dried olive and sage leaves are simmered to create a natural dye bath that produces soft, sage-green tones with beautiful natural mottling. Stonewashed for immediate softness, these generous napkins drape beautifully beside a plate or knotted casually through a napkin ring. The natural variation between pieces is a hallmark of their handcrafted origins.
care: Machine wash cold, colors will gently evolve

name: Amphora Terracotta Bud Vase
description: Hand-thrown miniature amphora vessel with delicate dual loop handles, fired in raw red clay to house dried botanical stems.
longDescription: A sculptural homage to ancient Mediterranean vessels, this miniature amphora is hand-thrown on the potter's wheel and fitted with two delicate loop handles — each one pinched and attached by hand. Fired in raw red terracotta without glaze, it celebrates the honest beauty of unadorned clay. Designed primarily for dried botanicals, grasses, and preserved stems, it also holds water for a single fresh-cut flower.
care: Wipe clean, avoid prolonged water exposure

name: The Aura Grand 16-Piece Tasting Suite
description: Complete flagship 4-person table setting combining dinner plates, pasta bowls, coffee mugs, and brushed gold cutlery.
longDescription: The ultimate expression of the Aura & Earth aesthetic — a complete table setting for four that harmonizes our most beloved pieces into one cohesive collection. Includes 4 Heritage Dinner Plates, 4 Hearthstone Pasta Bowls, 4 Oatmeal Artisan Mugs, and a 4-piece Champagne Gold Flatware Set. Each piece is individually crafted and bears the subtle variations that mark genuine handmade tableware. Presented in premium sustainable packaging — a transformative gift for newlyweds, new homeowners, or anyone who believes beautiful meals begin with a beautiful table.
